description: How guard-scope recognises an agent's commits. Seen on 16 Oct 2026 (docs/decisions.md 16 Oct (l), locus-probe session 9598935): a flow's create_commit records the flow's display name in the AI Catalog as author and committer name, and its service account's email, service_account_group_<group id>_<hash>@noreply.gitlab.com, as both emails; the service account's username (ai-<flow>-<group>) does not appear. So a commit is the flow's when its author or committer name, or the local part of either email, matches authorPattern: the flows must be created with exactly these display names. A commit whose author or committer email local part matches serviceAccountEmail but no flow is a service account that is not a Locus flow; guard-scope blocks it on graph/, revert/ and rollback/ branches.
